Maria Lopez: Quick help - need to route a POC quote for BetaCorp. 3mo POC, asking for 25% off list and $12k prepaid commit. What exact Salesforce/CPQ fields do I populate and what's the approval path?

Priya Singh: Use these CPQ meta fields: Discount_Percent__c, Discount_Reason__c, Commit_Type__c, Commit_Value__c, Commit_Tier__c, Special_Terms__c, Approval_Routing__c, Security_Questionnaire_Link__c, Quote_Approval_Status__c. Set Discount_Reason__c = "POC - enterprise eval" and Commit_Tier__c = "POC-3MO".

Maria Lopez: where to attach the security questionnaire and rate card ref?

Priya Singh: Upload questionnaire to Account files and paste public share into Security_Questionnaire_Link__c. Add rate card url in Special_Terms__c and attach pricing worksheet. Use template "POC_3MO_template_v1" to prefill fields.

deal-desk-bot: Automated rule: discount >=20% triggers Deal Desk review -> RevOps -> VP Sales if >25%. SLA: 48h business hours, add 24h if Legal/Security review needed.

Nora Patel: RevOps note: If $12k is prepaid, set Commit_Type__c = "Monetary" and Commit_Value__c = "12000"; that changes recognition so Legal will want SOW.

Jake Chen: SE note: add Special_Terms__c = "telemetry event for token usage; auto-recommend Dedicated if >5M/mo" so we can surface capacity suggestions post-POC.

Maria Lopez: thanks all - I'll upload files now and kick approval. will ping when done.
